primitives.name: Inverted Weighting
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Factor weights inverted (where Galaxy weights rest-advantage +0.8, anti-Galaxy weights it -0.8).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'w_i^{\\text{anti}}': 'Dimensionless inverted weight for factor i ([-1, 1])', 'w_i^{\\text{prod}}': 'Dimensionless production model weight for factor i ([-1, 1])'}
primitives.assumptions: The production model's factor weights are calibrated; inversion creates a deliberate counter-model.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When $w_i^{\text{prod}} \neq 0$, the inverted weight enforces opposite directional sensitivity.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Inverted posterior odds ratios. GSE: Opposite action-value function.
layer2.telemetry: Correlation between production and anti-Galaxy factor loadings should be approximately -1.

primitives.name: Inverted Gate Logic
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Factor weights inverted (where Galaxy weights rest-advantage +0.8, anti-Galaxy weights it -0.8).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'G^{\\text{anti}}(x)': 'Boolean inverted gate function for input x (True/False)', 'G^{\\text{prod}}(x)': 'Production gate function for input x (True/False)'}
primitives.assumptions: The production gate function is deterministic and binary; logical negation creates mutual exclusivity.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Thresholded posterior predictive checks. GSE: Opposite policy gradients.
layer2.telemetry: The fraction of simultaneous publications between production and anti-Galaxy should approach 0.

primitives.name: Performance Aggregation
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Gate inverted: anti-Galaxy publishes when production Galaxy would gate, and gates when production would publish.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P^{\\text{anti}}': 'Independent performance metric for anti-Galaxy (e.g., accuracy, log-loss)', 'f^{\\text{agg}}': 'Aggregation function (e.g., mean, median)', '(y_j, \\hat{p}_j^{\\text{anti}})': 'Ground truth outcome and predicted probability for pick j from anti-Galaxy'}
primitives.assumptions: Each pick is an IID Bernoulli trial; independent metrics prevent contamination between models.
primitives.breakdown_regime: As the number of picks increases, the empirical distribution of anti-Galaxy performance converges to its true rate.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Independent cross-validation folds. GSE: Separate replay buffers.
layer2.telemetry: Variance in rolling window performance metrics should remain stable over time.

If the production model is well-calibrated, its inverted counterpart will generate noise-like predictions with poor performance. Conversely, if Anti-Galaxy exhibits unexpected profitability, it signals a meta-bug in the production pipeline—likely data leakage or overfitting to spurious correlations. This methodological framework provides empirical falsifiability, transforming a black-box prediction service into a transparent system where internal consistency can be rigorously tested through external contradiction.
